change: Enable native streaming callback cancellation after the first literal closing tool_call delimiter. All native full_text and token/profile data remain unmodified; scoring remains unchanged.
expected_improvement: Reduce unwanted trailing actions and generation time. Native cancellation and semantic correctness must be measured; this is not a native decode-throughput claim.
model: Official Qualcomm Qwen3-0.6B v0.62.2 W4A16 Snapdragon X Elite QAIRT bundle
control_difference: stop_after_tool_call is false; all other configuration fields are identical and both runs use the same clean commit.
development_command: pythonw -X utf8 scripts/observe_secretary_eval.py qairt-stop-candidate-dev-v1 dev --config local/qairt-stop-candidate.json --output-dir local/qairt-stop-recovery-0600
full_command: pythonw -X utf8 scripts/observe_secretary_eval.py qairt-stop-candidate-full-v1 all --config local/qairt-stop-candidate.json --output-dir local/qairt-stop-recovery-0600
control_full_command: pythonw -X utf8 scripts/observe_secretary_eval.py qairt-stop-control-full-v1 all --config local/qairt-stop-control.json --output-dir local/qairt-stop-recovery-0600
limitations: Literal streaming delimiter detection is not a JSON-aware grammar; malformed or semantically wrong actions remain failures.
Cancellation cannot undo suffix text already produced in the same native chunk.
QAIRT sampling retains the documented v0.6.1 bundle-default behavior; zero requested temperature does not establish greedy sampling.
Retain NOT_COMPARABLE against the historical baseline when evaluator provenance differs. Do not replace or re-freeze the baseline.
launch_note: Original waiting supervisor exited before inference. Recovery uses windowless Python; clean source and control/candidate inference configuration are unchanged.
